summary: Iteration 210: Verified HQ outreach report Boss-Brief backend changes (7/7 pytest pass incl. endpoint + unit test with seeded Luxury/Salons docs in Bangalore/Mumbai), confirmed nav regroup (one super-tab-studio = 'Feedback, AI Engineer & Brand Studio' stacked; one super-tab-security = 'Security & Database' stacked; no stray feedback/engineer/onboarding/brand/deployments/platform-load/database tabs), and ran a contrast sweep over all 22 tabs. Theme root is dark (#0f0f14 / cream text). However the hq-gold.css remap does NOT reach several light pastel panels so light cream text (#f3efe4) still renders on light pastel backgrounds — most notably Billing trial inputs (unreadable typed values), HQ Inbox message cards, Notifications amber cards, Mira-Leads 'latest search' panel, Team number-health, Tenants Grant chips, Security card gold panel, Database collection list and Deployment History panel. Also several btn-blue action buttons render DARK text on DARK bg because the theme forces #15151b bg while button class keeps dark text. Also 1 React hydration error (<span> inside <option>) and ~10 duplicate-key warnings.

Override recharts legend text (.recharts-legend-item-text) inside .hq-gold to cream.
Fix FollowUpPipeline column pills — remove pastel bg or override to #17171d with gold text.

critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdmin.jsx is 978 lines — exceeds 700-line threshold; split panel map and NAV_ITEMS into a separate module.
outreach_report.py build_report walks 2000+ rows per request without pagination; acceptable for daily, but if endpoint hit on dashboard load it will be slow once data grows.
In outreach_report.py _boss_today the `wa_q` dict is identical for salon and restaurant branches of the ternary — the ternary is a no-op (minor).
hq-gold.css does NOT cover pastel utility backgrounds (bg-amber-50 etc.) which is the entire source of the contrast failures above.

Nav regroup is confirmed (studio + security merged, no stray old tabs). The remaining work is pure CSS: /app/frontend/src/styles/hq-gold.css needs to also remap bg-amber-50/emerald-50/violet-50/rose-50/fuchsia-50 and btn-blue + .recharts-legend-item-text inside .hq-gold. Also SecurityCard, DatabasePanel, DeploymentHistoryPanel need dark-ink wrappers. Worst-30 offenders JSON saved to /app/test_reports/pytest/iter210_contrast.json for the main agent. Note that many r=1.02 'tab label' offenders are FALSE POSITIVES — those are active-pill gold-gradient buttons where the gradient uses background-image not background-color so the sweep walks up to the nav container and reports dark-on-dark. True offenders are the pastel-bg panels and btn-blue buttons listed above.
